---
applyTo: "notebooks/**"
excludeAgent: "cloud-agent"
---

When reviewing pull requests that change files under `notebooks/`, use the
`notebook-code-review` skill in `.github/skills/notebook-code-review/SKILL.md`.
Read `CONTRIBUTING.md` and assess model/task suitability and usefulness as well
as correctness, portability, licensing, documentation, and notebook integration.
Include README, helper, asset, deletion, and rename changes in notebook context.
Report only substantiated, actionable findings introduced by the changes.
Do not execute submitted code or claim runtime, hardware, or licensing checks
passed without evidence. State missing evidence and incomplete coverage explicitly.
